note: Per-million-token USD rates for Gemini API models used by ADK agents. Prices change without notice -- verify against each entry's source_url before relying on a number for a real budget decision. Standard (interactive/online) tier only -- no Batch API pricing (ADK's live-agent plugin path never issues Batch API calls, confirmed by source grep of google-adk's models/plugins modules; a batch call is a separate async job-submission API that never flows through BasePlugin.after_model_callback). Text/image/video input rate only -- Gemini prices audio input separately (typically higher) on several models; audio calls are priced at the text rate here, which under-charges audio-heavy invocations. schema_version 2 adds optional per-model long-context tiering (see 'long_context_threshold_tokens'/'long_context_model_key') -- verified P0 fix, Phase 2 W1.

cache_multipliers._note: Gemini's default (automatic/implicit) context caching bills only a read-time discount at 0.1x the model's fresh input rate -- verified per-model against ai.google.dev's published cached-input rates (every model checked, including the >200k long-context tiers, divides out to exactly 0.1x of that tier's own input rate; re-verified 2026-08-14 across 10 models). There is no cache-write surcharge and no cache_creation token field in GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata (confirmed by inspecting the actual installed Pydantic model), so write multipliers are 0 by design, not a placeholder. cache_read billing correctness also depends on prompt_token_count already including cached tokens (so fresh_tokens = prompt_token_count - cache_read is not double-billing) -- confirmed directly from the installed google-genai SDK's GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata docstring: 'prompt_token_count ... When cached_content is set, this also includes the number of tokens in the cached content.'

gemini-2.5-pro.note: Standard tier, <=200k token prompts. Prompts >200k tokens are priced via the long_context tier below (schema_version 2) -- Phase 1 flagged this as unmodeled; now fixed.

gemini-2.5-pro-long-context.note: Synthetic tier-only entry, never matched directly against a raw ADK model_version string. Applied by _pricing.resolve_model_for_call when a real call's prompt_token_count exceeds gemini-2.5-pro's long_context_threshold_tokens (200,000).

gemini-2.5-flash.note: Standard tier, text/image/video input. No context-length tiering published for this model. Audio input bills at $1.00/Mtok, not modeled here.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.note: Standard tier, text/image/video input. No context-length tiering published for this model. Audio input bills at $0.30/Mtok, not modeled here.

gemini-2.0-flash.note: Deprecated by Google (shut down 2026-06-01). Kept for pricing historical eval sessions recorded before the shutdown; will not appear in new runs.

gemini-3.5-flash.note: Standard tier. No context-length tiering or time-limited promotional rate published for this model.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: Standard tier. No context-length tiering or time-limited promotional rate published for this model.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-14 (Phase 2 W1 P0 fix): prior table entry ($1.50/$7.50) was the POST-promotion rate, not the rate actually in effect. Google's published standard rate is $0.75 input / $3.75 output through 2026-12-31, rising to $1.50/$7.50 after. This is a time-based tier the 90-day staleness guard will force a re-check on well before the 2026-12-31 change (re-verify on or before that date regardless of the staleness guard's own timing).

gemini-3.7-flash.note: NEW 2026-08-14 (Phase 2 W1 P0 fix): missing from the table entirely. Standard rate $0.75 input / $3.75 output through 2026-12-31, rising to $1.50/$7.50 after -- same promotional-period caveat as gemini-3.6-flash; re-verify before 2026-12-31.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.note: NEW 2026-08-14 (Phase 2 W1 P0 fix): missing from the table entirely. Standard tier, text/image/video input. Audio input bills at $0.50/Mtok, not modeled here. No context-length tiering published.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.note: NEW 2026-08-14 (Phase 2 W1 P0 fix): missing from the table entirely. Preview model. Standard tier, <=200k token prompts; long-context tier below.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview-long-context.note: Synthetic tier-only entry for gemini-3.1-pro-preview calls with prompt_token_count > 200,000. See gemini-2.5-pro-long-context for the same pattern.
